items.notes: FAST Candidate Reviewer re-fetched exact 02f7707f..fd7cb6b range: three implementation commits touch only LocalLlamaProvider, bootstrap wiring, and a fail-closed pinned-source patch script. The patch extends upstream InferenceEngine, adds a JNI reset that refuses missing SYSTEM boundaries, trims template chat history to SYSTEM only, removes KV strictly after system_prompt_position, resets short-term/sampler state, and makes LocalLlamaProvider preserve identity fingerprint only on successful reset. Adversarial review rejected treating this as the complete warm-rehydrate fix: current coldStartPrompt still mixes identity with session continuity, so ordinary prepare() intentionally remains on full setSystemPrompt for session changes. The candidate fixes the previously impossible reset prerequisite only. The new patch script is transitively cache-invalidated now because bootstrap changed; future edits to that script should also update bootstrap or the APK cache key/path list. No hosted CI/APK/device claim was made.

items.notes: FAST Candidate Reviewer re-fetched exact ab247228..da20872a: one 83-line diagnosis artifact only. Cross-checks against AiContext, LocalLlamaProvider, the pinned ai_chat.cpp processSystemPrompt/processUserPrompt behavior, Furina's Jinja incremental formatter patch, and the accepted reset primitive show that a second ROLE_SYSTEM incremental decode after the stable system_prompt_position can carry session continuity and be removed by the next reset. Reviewer rejected using processSystemPrompt because it resets long-term state and advances the preserved boundary, and again rejected USER injection because confirmed C2 already identifies role contamination. Risks are explicitly bounded: consecutive SYSTEM template behavior, overflow, partial failure fingerprints, and AAR cache invalidation require implementation/MEDIUM validation. No runtime, CI, APK, latency, persona, or memory-quality improvement is claimed.
